front_door.description: Single-leaf door recessed under ornate stucco/columned porch; reached by several steps up from pavement; dark-coloured door. There is also a sunken lightwell/steps down beside the porch to a lower-ground level.

access_notes: Low brick front wall with narrow pedestrian opening from pavement
Short front path with steps up to raised ground-floor entrance
Sunken basement/lightwell immediately in front/alongside the façade
Pavement trees and a lamp post along kerb near the frontage
No hydrant marker or street standpipe sign visible
obstacles: Wheelie bins in the front garden area
Steps up to door and lightwell drop beside the entrance
Street tree close to the frontage
rear_access_note: From satellite view the property is mid-terrace with long enclosed rear gardens backing onto other gardens; no rear alley or side passage visible.
parking: Kerbside on Kellett Road outside/near the address in residents’ parking bays; single carriageway residential street with parking on both sides.
